limits: The source routine indexes this 196-entry pointer table by an actor kind, and the table is identical in both hashed captures. Its 392 bytes are static data, not Z80 instructions; the targets are numeric code candidates, not proof that any handler is completely decoded. Eighteen entry addresses occurred as instruction starts in eight checked paths; seven had no reached entry there, which is not proof they cannot run through other inputs. Private exact-fetch and RAM-parity checks across twelve paths found no executed table bytes. Full pointer values, instruction bytes, graphics and disassembly remain private.
